purpose: Diagnose why the prospectively frozen crossing-time test failed. These summaries are post-hoc diagnostics and are not confirmatory evidence for the failed preregistered predictions.
diagnosis: The investment crossing-time endpoint was censored at 401 in essentially all cells, so the two-trait timing statistic had almost no leverage.
Access-accessible mutation increased terminal access response magnitude in both visitor histories and increased single-trait crossing frequency.
Investment-accessible mutation did not increase investment response consistently across visitor histories; the aggregate magnitude was essentially unchanged relative to equal mutation supply.
Positive pleiotropic coupling could not produce coordinated crossing because the investment trait almost never reached the preregistered 0.05 sustained threshold.
next_question: Why does standing variation strongly filter investment response while the declared de novo mutation treatment does not rescue it over 400 years?
claim_boundary: Do not treat the 1.65 access ratio as a preregistered effect size.
Do not infer natural mutation rates or that architecture is generally more mutation-accessible than floral signals.
A new prospective design is required to distinguish mutation supply, population size, selection strength and standing variation.
